Surgically Retry Failed, OOM, Timed-Out, or Cancelled Chunks

Source: R/job.R
slurm_retry.Rd

Resubmits only unsuccessful array chunks while preserving already-completed chunk checkpoints on disk. Supports adaptive resource escalation: when adaptive = TRUE (default), chunks that failed with OUT_OF_MEMORY automatically scale --mem by auto_mem_multiplier (capped at max_mem_mb) and chunks that failed with TIMEOUT automatically scale --time by auto_time_multiplier (capped at max_time_minutes). Records per-chunk retry provenance accessible via slurm_retry_history().

Usage

slurm_retry(
  job,
  chunks = NULL,
  mem_multiplier = NULL,
  time_multiplier = NULL,
  resources = NULL,
  adaptive = TRUE,
  auto_mem_multiplier = 1.5,
  auto_time_multiplier = 1.5,
  max_mem_mb = 524288L,
  max_time_minutes = 10080
)

Arguments

job

A slurmpilot_job handle.

chunks

Optional integer vector of chunk IDs to retry. Defaults to all chunks currently in FAILED, OUT_OF_MEMORY, TIMEOUT, or CANCELLED.

mem_multiplier

Optional explicit numeric multiplier to bump --mem on retry (overrides adaptive OOM scaling when supplied).

time_multiplier

Optional explicit numeric multiplier to bump --time on retry (overrides adaptive TIMEOUT scaling when supplied).

resources

Optional explicit replacement slurmpilot_resources object (takes precedence over multipliers and adaptive escalation).

adaptive

Logical; if TRUE (default), automatically escalates --mem for OUT_OF_MEMORY failures and --time for TIMEOUT failures.

auto_mem_multiplier

Adaptive --mem escalation factor for OUT_OF_MEMORY chunks. Default 1.5.

auto_time_multiplier

Adaptive --time escalation factor for TIMEOUT chunks. Default 1.5.

max_mem_mb

Maximum memory ceiling in MB for adaptive escalation. Default 524288L (512 GiB).

max_time_minutes

Maximum walltime ceiling in minutes for adaptive escalation. Default 10080 (7 days).

Value

Updated slurmpilot_job handle with appended $retry_history provenance.

See also

slurm_retry_history(), scale_resources()

Examples

be <- mock_slurm_backend(max_workers = 1L)
job <- slurm_submit(
  be, function(x) x^2, as.list(1:4),
  resources = resource_spec(4L, chunk_size = 2L, mem_mb = 512L),
  fault_injection = list(oom_chunks = 2L, fail_once = TRUE)
)
slurm_wait(job, poll_interval = 0.05)
#> 
#> ── slurmpilot Job Status: slurmpilot_job [PARTIAL_FAILURE] 
#> • Progress: 1/2 chunks (50%) | running=0, pending=0, failed=0, oom=1,
#>   timeout=0, cancelled=0
#> • Peak RSS max: 104.6 MB | Cumulative walltime: 0.98s
job <- slurm_retry(job)
slurm_wait(job, poll_interval = 0.05)
#> 
#> ── slurmpilot Job Status: slurmpilot_job [COMPLETED] 
#> • Progress: 2/2 chunks (100%) | running=0, pending=0, failed=0, oom=0,
#>   timeout=0, cancelled=0
#> • Peak RSS max: 106.9 MB | Cumulative walltime: 0.98s
slurm_retry_history(job)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 9
#>   retry_round timestamp             chunk_id trigger_state old_mem_mb new_mem_mb
#>         <int> <chr>                    <int> <chr>              <int>      <int>
#> 1           1 2026-11-24T19:33:28.…        2 OUT_OF_MEMORY        512        768
#> # ℹ 3 more variables: old_time_sec <int>, new_time_sec <int>, adaptive <lgl>
unlink(be$root_dir, recursive = TRUE)
